name: slant
description: 2D · dark background, left-aligned headline, phone with a thick accent rim rotated in the plane, bleeding off the right.
design_notes: Social/community dark theme. Dark background from the main colour. Left-aligned bold white headline whose key words are in the accent colour. The phone has a thick rim in the accent colour, is rotated about 14 degrees counter-clockwise in the plane and bleeds off the right/bottom edge, giving a dynamic, divided-frame feel (no perspective).
